subject.title: fix(codex): add WebSocket handshake timeout to app-server transport

question: Should the Codex WebSocket upgrade deadline inherit the existing resolved app-server timeout, or should OpenClaw establish a separate fixed 30-second connection policy?
rationale: Both policies prevent indefinite hangs, but a fixed deadline can intentionally reject existing slow remote setups before their configured request window, so the permanent timeout ownership needs explicit confirmation.

options.title: Inherit existing timeout
options.body: Plumb the resolved app-server timeout into transport construction so connection setup and requests share the user’s existing deadline.

options.title: Adopt fixed 30 seconds
options.body: Keep the fixed cutoff and explicitly define remote upgrade handshakes longer than 30 seconds as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Inherit existing timeout
recommendation.body: Plumb the resolved app-server timeout into transport construction so connection setup and requests share the user’s existing deadline.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor to the Codex app-server timeout, lifecycle, and configuration surfaces involved in the choice.
